title: Publicist's cover letter for the Garner memoir
summary: Martha Glaser's note marking the anniversary of Garner's death and sharing Stewart's memoir.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing the interview: thanks, goodbyes and tape running out

blocks.x:
Dear Friends;

January 2nd, 1981, will mark the fourth anniversary of the death of Erroll Garner.

Memories of him, both as a man and as an artist, continue with an immediacy; his music remains ever present, ever fresh.

From bassist Slam Stewart, who was Erroll's good friend and performing companion, we have another memoir, which we wish to share with you on this occasion.

We join again with friends in remembrance.

Sincerely,

Martha Glaser
